prompt: What state is the home of the losing team of the World Series three years before "Old Shufflefoot" managed his team to victory?
answer: Michigan—the Detroit Tigers lost the 1945 World Series to the Chicago Cubs, three years before Lou “Old Shufflefoot” Boudreau led Cleveland to victory in 1948.
